title: Spec and quiz page
caption: Hands-on: finish the grill into a spec, build the quiz page, play it and fix it.

steps.first: Finish the grill in the chat you left open; it writes the spec.
steps.second: Paste the spec back into the Workflow and sign it off.
steps.third: Step “Build the quiz”: a new chat turns the spec into quiz.html; open it by double-click.
steps.fourth: Step “Play it and fix it”: play, note what you notice, and let a new chat fix it.

done: A quiz.html you have played once and fixed once.

workflow.label: Open the quiz Workflow
workflow.pick: Today’s Workflow, “Turn a source into a quiz”, is already picked. Each step has its prompt to copy, for an AI chat or a coding agent; paste each result back into its box.

help.label: Where you're stuck
help.placeholder: Paste what the AI answered, or describe where you're stuck…
help.copyTip: Paste this prompt into an AI you are allowed to use.
help.noError: (I haven't pasted anything yet: ask me what I see.)

chats.openAIChatTip: Open an empty {chat} chat in a new tab, then paste the prompt

help.step: Grill: Grill me and write the spec, then Execute: Build the quiz, Play it and fix it

talking-points.description: Building in a fresh chat from the spec is the point of the day: the spec carries the shared understanding, not the long interview. If a page does not open, the Help prompt explains the error in plain words.
